Title: Public preview: Azure Purview powered search in Azure Synapse Analytics workspaces

Body.Content:
Data scientists and data engineers using Azure Synapse Analytics can now find data they need effortlessly with the help of a native Azure Purview powered search within Synapse Studio. This integration is in public preview. Get started today by connecting your Azure Purview account to Azure Synapse Analytics. 

Learn more.

Connect Purview to Synapse.
